canonical_status_reason: This record formalizes ACCRE and the VMS triad as a schema-valid ITEM economic ontology candidate rather than a financial instrument or token launch.
function: Define the core ITEM currency ontology
Separate symbolic denomination grammar from market-facing financial claims
Provide a reproducible record for future currency artifacts
Anchor ACCRE and VMS inside machine-readable canon review

DOCTRINAL_LAYER.description: Defines ACCRE as the interpreter of value relations and ITEM as the canon system that mints artifact status.

DENOMINATION_LAYER.description: Defines the VMS triad: Vacuo as scarcity-to-memory, Mute as memory-to-exchange, and Singulus as exchange-to-fixed-scarcity.

GOVERNANCE_LAYER.description: Requires future currency candidates to identify unit family, issuance logic, substrate, visual grammar, provenance, and veto risks.

IMPLEMENTATION_LAYER.description: Can be rendered into schemas, fixture data, artifact viewers, interface labels, and candidate economic-unit records.

symbolic_claims: ACCRE interprets value; ITEM mints artifact status.
Vacuo, Mute, and Singulus are denomination grammar, not automatic money claims.
Canonization produces symbolic scarcity only after structured judgment.
Economic mythology must be separated from financial promises until implementation and legal review exist.

implementation_surface.notes: The ontology can drive UI, schemas, simulations, and visual families, but this record does not authorize sale, token issuance, or investment framing.

validation_requirements: Future denomination records must specify family_class, denomination_relation, issuance_logic, substrate, visual_grammar, anti_entropy_claim, provenance, and veto_risks
Do not imply investment value, legal tender status, or token launch without separate legal and implementation review

provenance.source: ITEM repository normalization pass and prior ACCRE/VMS candidate doctrine
provenance.created_by: ITEM Research Council / GPT-assisted repo operation

judgment_result.reason: Strong coherence, provenance, and implementation surface as an ontology record. It is not canon-ready until examples and render templates exist.
judgment_result.next_action: Create denomination-specific child records for Vacuo, Mute, and Singulus and add fixture validation.

review_notes.reason: This is the first schema-valid economic-unit record connecting ACCRE and VMS to repository governance.
review_notes.next_action: Keep as candidate under canon/records until scoring, examples, and validation tooling mature.
